decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.
Condition : 3 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Retention and reduction of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse
